statement.name: GetUserActions
statement.sql:
Convert(varchar(36),dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionType.LookUpCode) as UserActionID, dbo.PlatformUserAction.ActionID, dbo.PlatformUserAction.OnDateTime, ISNULL(dbo.PlatformUserAction.Comments, ' ') AS Comments, dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionType.LongDisplayValue LongDisplayValue, ISNULL(dbo.People.NamePrefix + ' ', '') + ISNULL(dbo.People.FirstName + ' ', '') + ISNULL(dbo.People.MiddleName + ' ', '') + ISNULL(dbo.People.LastName, '') AS ActionTakenBy, Convert(varchar(36),dbo.PlatformUserAction.ByUserID) as ByUserID, Convert(varchar(36),dbo.PlatformUserAction.OnResourceID) as OnResourceID, dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionType.ProcessTypeLookUpCode as ProcessTypeLookUpCode, LookupPlatformUserActionType.ShortDisplayValue as ActionTypeDisplay
FROM dbo.PlatformUserAction INNER JOIN dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionType ON dbo.PlatformUserAction.ActionTypeLookUpCode = dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionType.LookupCode INNER JOIN dbo.People ON dbo.PlatformUserAction.ByUserID = dbo.People.UserId INNER JOIN dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionProcess ON dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionType.ProcessTypeLookUpCode = dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionProcess.LookupCode
